notes.title: The Forgotten King Update
notes.content:
This update introduces The Forgotten King boss Fight, New achievements and rewards from the bartender, new pets, Craftable Armor and Weapons, a New Magic Staff Weapon Type, Enemy Type, headshots, new visual effects when gems are socketed on weapons.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43052195/e303859ca64ad22ffe59148a623e90809559be51.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43052195/fa0bd591ca40e7a743a976b0d4d4ee014053b3d3.jpg[/img]

One of the new mounts that can be obtained through the bartender inside the tavern.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43052195/71f75be6cb80aa4bec56583731619f59568f97bc.jpg[/img]

The new spider pet which can only be obtained by defeating The Forgotten King.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43052195/f14fe33ba8166c3494788479a0232463341cef3c.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43052195/93dbcc95f26d4b6b730b3e8eb93fd3c25958b359.jpg[/img]

Notifications when defenses are destroyed and difficult enemy's enter through the portal.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43052195/4ebed5bca36c7278249524abf8730ed63f311fac.jpg[/img]

The new spider enemy will constantly spawn smaller spiders while alive. the Spiders spawned will lose health over time but are very quick and can overwhelm defenses if they are not taken care of.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43052195/34b90537e84c40eeb75b8ea686179c1e7423f732.jpg[/img]

Sewer Junctions and The dungeons now have 2 Guardians stones to defend.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43052195/53c09a9f00ddb4f320441f244dadd6fc7945969e.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43052195/3320c4a0d48059f6373c9eebf34438f71de18dc3.jpg[/img]

Bug Fixes/Changes
- New Mystic Armor added
- all Skills now have a much faster casting speed.
- Enemy's now have a level above there health bar.
- socketed gems now change the weapon impact effect when you are attacking enemy's.
- socketed gems will now produce an aura effect around the weapon.
- when using ranged weapons like bows and magic staffs you can get headshots on all enemy's which will cause double the damage.
- Sewer Junction and The Dungeons now have 2 Guardian stones to defend.
- as you progress through the game the enemy's coming through the portal will be faster and stronger no matter the difficulty.
- Updated the main menu
- updated the Achievements Menu
- Skeleton's with bombs will now focus more on taking out defenses that they come across rather then just running straight towards the Guardian Stone.
- You can now roll without being locked on by double tapping the jump button.
- enemy's who are stuck on objects or stuck in the portal will now die if they are unable to get unstuck after 15 seconds.
- Made changes to the Build mode ui to make using and placing defenses more clear.
- Fixed some issues in multiplayer where the enemy's were not always playing the same animation for all players.
- fixed a bug when fighting Omnibolt where if anyone who was not the host died it would cause the defeat screen to pop up.
- When fighting Omnibolt in multiplayer he will now change who he is attacking depending on who is closer to him and who is left alive.
- increased the performance when lots of enemy's are on screen at once.
- When upgrading items it now shows everything that is equipped.
- When bulk selling items in the storage container it would not give you gold for those items sold.

notes.title: Nightmare Update
notes.content:
This Update introduces the Nightmare difficulty, New enemies, Mini Boss's, Player Mounts, New pets, Armor, Weapons, and the Mystic item Rarity.

New Enemy Type's and New Mini Boss

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43052195/d1bbe31e6a4e018a36923fe5437776444afb30d9.jpg[/img]

Added the option to hotkey items so that you can change weapons, armor and pets without having to open the menu every time.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43052195/11f6c86314ca0e8c272833c40f446e62f756298b.jpg[/img]

Minor Changes/Bug Fixes
- Increased Weapon skill mana use.
- Significantly increased Weapon Skill Damage.
- Major optimizations to increase performance when lots of enemies are on screen at once.
- Fixed a bug where Enemies would stop moving and stand still until attacked or in range of the player.
- made some changes to the Castle Guards and there Collision.
- Removed Pet Collision with the player.
- Enemies are now invulnerable until they walk outside of the portal,
- Fixed a bug where materials were not able to be picked up when hovered hover.
- Made Changes to Loot Armor and Weapon Stats
- Increased Strength health and Speed of all enemies on Hard and Insane Mode.
- Increased Silver material Drop Rate
- Fixed a bug where the bow's 2nd and 3rd ability would not damage OmniBolt and other enemies.
- Arrow's now instantly hit your target when fired.
- Made changes to Weapon Skill Effects and other effects in game to improve performace.
- fixed a bug where you could jump out of Omni Bolt's Lair.
- fixed an issue with enemy spawns that would cause the wave to be stuck in the combat phase.
- Added 4 hotkey slots
- The lich now has the Ability to heal surrounding Enemies
